comment: Every door to Preferences lands on its row. Display Colour Profile... (Help > Display Settings...) and View > Exposure Stops... opened the Display page at its top, the profile row 13 of 18 and the stops row 10, and Help > Keyboard Shortcuts opened with its first chord at y 762 of 976. Each door is pressed by id, Help's 508 and 501 and View's 60, and the dump's preferences_search block reads the page opened, the row marked, the scroll, the marked row's top below the pane's and whether all of it shows. The last press opens the Display door over a Preferences already open on Keyboard Shortcuts, which has to land as well as a first open does.
